Messages.Author: A.B. Lucas
Messages.Body:
IN the inferior version of Telepathic vote counting it
says you can cancel a political action and take the card
back into your hand (if there is one).
Does this mean that the acting Vampire ends up tapped
or untapped ? It seems to me that he might be untapped as
there are very few circumstances that you would want to
cancel a cardless political action (like burning Archon or
the Elysium) unless the Vamp would be untapped at the end.

Cheers
Alun

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


Since it doesn't say untap the acting vampire, the acting
vampire is not untapped.

If you don't need to cancel a cardless political action, then
you don't have to. - The text was (a remarkable example of)
WotC's effort to cover all possibilities.

And, If you're facing a losing vote when someone has played
Elder Kindred Network (caller loses X+1 pool where X is the
number of votes the PA fails by), you may indeed want to cancel
the action.
